claim.why_it_matters: Printed as a numbered subheading like 1.2.1-1.2.3 (page 583, '####' headings), but transcribed as a plain paragraph, so the Report Writer subscripting restriction has no heading.

verdict.reasoning: The 300 dpi render of page 584 (XIII-2) prints '1.2.4 Subscripting' on its own line, flush left, set apart from the body paragraph below it, which is indented. That is a numbered subsection heading in the same style as 1.2.1 to 1.2.3. The page-583 transcription gives those three as '#### 1.2.x' headings. The page-584 transcription has the words '1.2.4 Subscripting' but as a plain paragraph with no '####'. No text is missing: the wording of the heading and the restriction under it ('neither a sum counter nor the special registers LINE-COUNTER and PAGE-COUNTER can be used as a subscript') matches the PDF. The defect is structural only: the heading markup is missing, so 1.2.4 is absent from the document's heading hierarchy. The claim describes this accurately.
